USTEC.rule: Each copy keeps every real trade's direction, clock time of day, stop distance, target distance and holding time, but enters on a random trading day of the same price history (bars, entry at the bar open). Stop is assumed first when stop and target fall in the same bar. p = (copies with mean R >= real mean R + 1) / (copies + 1). Raw-gate screen: p <= 0.10 (lenient on purpose: it removes market drift, it does not prove an edge).
